claims.quote: When you preregister your research, you're simply specifying your research plan in advance of your study and submitting it to a registry.

says.covers: an experiment's prediction recorded before it runs

claims.quote: But the same data cannot be used to generate and test a hypothesis, which can happen unintentionally and reduce the credibility of your results.

claims.quote: We believe architects can communicate, validate and preserve architectural characteristics in an automated, continual manner, which is the key to building evolutionary architectures.

claims.quote: In traceability IA, links between requirements, specifications, design elements, and tests are captured, and these relationships can be analysed to determine the scope of an initiating change.

claims.quote: Regression Test Selection (RTS) aims to reduce regression testing cost by only selecting and running the tests that may be affected by code changes.

says.covers: the tests a change can reach, picked from a map of what each test ran

claims.quote: We implemented the basic HyRTS technique by combining the method and file granularity RTS.

says.covers: tests picked by the functions a change touched

claims.quote: RTS techniques working on finer granularities may be more precise in selecting tests, while techniques working on coarser granularities may have lower overhead.

says.raises: the overhead of picking tests at a finer grain

claims.quote: Ekstazi implements Regression Test Selection (RTS) for Java, which is a technique to detect a set of tests that can be skipped after a code change.

claims.quote: Variant analysis is the process of using a known security vulnerability as a seed to find similar problems in your code.

claims.quote: Querying code using CodeQL is the most efficient way to perform variant analysis.
